title: Woman in Swimsuit on Patio, 1950s USA B&W Snapshot Photograph
description: A 1950s black and white vintage snapshot depicting a smiling woman sitting on a metal folding chair on a sunlit patio. She is wearing a mid-century two-piece swimsuit paired with a sleeveless vest/shirt. Handwritten captions on the front border read 'Mommy' at the top and 'Healing Waters' at the bottom. The background displays brickwork, glass windows, and lawn furniture representative of post-war American suburban leisure.
